plugins.name: Word documents
plugins.description: Opens Word documents (.docx, .docm, .dotx, .dotm) as themselves, laid out by Kalem: styles, lists, tables, pictures, notes, comments and tracked changes read; text edited and formatted (marks, typefaces, sizes, colors, paragraph styles, alignment, indents, spacing, lists), tracked changes accepted and rejected, comments added, answered, edited, resolved and deleted, every other part kept byte for byte

plugins.name: Elixir
plugins.description: Elixir, EEx and HEEx: highlighting, and the language server (Expert where installed, ElixirLS otherwise) for completion, hover, definition, diagnostics and formatting

plugins.name: Git
plugins.description: The repository's status as a document, lazygit's panels in magit's form: changed files with their diffs under them (Tab), staged by file, hunk or line with magit's keys, committed, pushed and pulled; branches and stashes; changed lines marked beside the lines; on Doom's SPC g keys, with the arrows, Enter and Escape

plugins.name: Image viewer
plugins.description: Shows pictures (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, ICO, QOI, TGA, PNM, DDS, OpenEXR, HDR, SVG) with zoom, pan, turns and their EXIF information; a JPEG is turned or flipped by its orientation tag only

plugins.name: PDF viewer
plugins.description: Shows PDF files (ISO 32000) page by page with their outline, page labels and links; search, copy and the terminal read the pages' text

plugins.name: Rust
plugins.description: Rust: highlighting for the current editions, and rust-analyzer for completion, documentation, definitions, references, rename, diagnostics and formatting

plugins.name: Excel workbooks
plugins.description: Opens, edits and saves Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm) as themselves: only the edited cells change, charts, pivot tables and macros are kept byte for byte
